artifact_hash.description: On VERSION_PUBLISHED: sha256 of the pinned proposal text (proposal.md, then proposal.yaml with phase/phase_history/clock_start removed), as src/clock.ts computes it. Distinct from content_hash, which chains the event itself.

amendment_class.description: On a VERSION_PUBLISHED that follows an earlier pin: what kind of amendment this version is, declared by its author. Carries no clock force until OTCS-0013 ratifies; src/clock.ts reads it informationally meanwhile.

supersedes_version.description: On a VERSION_PUBLISHED that follows an earlier pin: the artifact_version it replaces.

anchor_id.description: Manifest recorded by an EVIDENCE_ANCHORED event (BITCOIN-ANCHORING.md).

covers_through_event.description: Last ledger event the anchored manifest committed. Always precedes this event: a manifest cannot commit the hash of a ledger already containing the event that describes it.

anchor_status.description: PENDING = digest fixed, not yet submitted. SUBMITTED = sent to a calendar server. CONFIRMED = verified against a Bitcoin block. Only CONFIRMED carries an external timestamp; the other two must never be described as anchored.

note.description: Human-readable context. Never load-bearing — nothing may depend on parsing it.
